modeTitle.code: OxeCode: terminals and agents in your workspaces

activityCenter.nothingToReadText: Every activity item is already read.

report.title: Report a problem
report.description: This is the issue we would open on GitHub. Nothing is sent until you choose what to do with it.
report.bodyHint: Version, system and recent diagnostics are included with secrets and your home folder removed. Read it, add the steps, and edit anything you do not want to share.
report.failed: The report could not be prepared.
report.truncated: The text is too long for a link, so GitHub receives the first part. Use Copy text to share all of it.

guide.title: Keyboard shortcuts
guide.f6ToProgram: In a terminal pane with “Send F6 to the program” on (in its ⋯ menu), F6 and Shift+F6 go to the program there, for mc, htop or tig; {{toggle}} still makes Tab move focus out of it.

terminal.tabMovesFocus: Tab moves focus in the terminal

focus.nextRegion: Move focus to the next region
focus.previousRegion: Move focus to the previous region

terminalFocus.hint: Terminal. Press F6 to leave, or {{toggle}} to make Tab move focus.
terminalFocus.hintF6ToProgram: Terminal. F6 goes to the program here. Press {{toggle}} to make Tab move focus.

newDatabase.label: New local database

divider.hint: Drag, or use the arrow keys; Enter for more

offline.title: You are offline

palette.title: Command palette

boundary.title: Something went wrong while showing {{what}}.
boundary.titlePart: Something went wrong while showing this part of the app.
boundary.message: The rest of OXESpace keeps working. Try again, and if it happens again, report it from the Help menu.

crash.title: OXESpace could not show this window.
crash.message: Your terminals, agents and conversations keep running. Try again; if it happens again, reload the window and report the problem from the Help menu.

errors.commandMissing: {{command}} was not found. Install it or add it to your PATH, then try again.
errors.somethingMissing: A file or folder it needed does not exist.
errors.noPermission: No permission to use a file or folder it needed.
errors.busy: A file it needed is in use by another program. Close it and try again.
errors.databaseBusy: The local database is busy. Try again in a moment.
errors.unresolved: Could not reach the server: the address could not be resolved. Check your connection.
errors.refused: The connection was refused. Check that the service is running.
errors.reset: The connection was closed unexpectedly. Try again.
errors.timeout: It took too long to respond. Try again.
errors.offline: Could not connect. Check your internet connection or proxy.
errors.signedOut: You are not signed in, or the session expired. Sign in again.
errors.forbidden: Your account does not have access to this.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests for now. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.notGit: This folder is not a Git repository.

agentSetup.readyBoth: OxeCode and OxeChat can use it.
agentSetup.readyCodeOnly: OxeCode can run it. OxeChat needs Claude Code or Codex.
agentSetup.checkingDetail: Looking for the commands on your PATH.
agentSetup.partialDetail: Open Agents settings to see what is missing.
agentSetup.noneDetail: OXESpace runs agents as local CLIs. Install Claude Code or Codex, make sure the command is on your PATH, then check again.
agentSetup.uncheckedDetail: Check which agent CLIs are installed on this machine.

start.prompt: Select a folder to start your first agentic terminal workspace.

notice.unsavedEditor: Workspace has unsaved editor changes. Save or close the file before closing the workspace.
notice.noTerminal: No visible terminal to run the command.
notice.needsTerminal: Open a workspace with a terminal pane first.
notice.agentFailed: Failed to start agent in pane

button.label: Team
button.needsWorkspace: Open a workspace to open its team
button.needsProject: Select an OxeChat project to open its team
button.otherViews: Team is available in OxeCode and OxeChat

team.unavailable: Team is unavailable in this runtime.
team.description: Persistent roles for this project, shared by OxeCode and OxeChat.
team.note: Members are saved independently of sessions. Creating a role does not start an agent. Automatic delivery sends inbox messages to a connected idle OxeChat conversation. It pauses after failure, interruption or restart; OxeCode sessions read their inbox through MCP.

connection.idle: Session connected · idle, a message starts it again
connection.disconnected: Session disconnected · reconnect to authorize MCP

team.connectTitle: Lets the active session read and send this member's messages through MCP
team.empty: No members yet. Add a coordinator or another project role.
team.name: Member name
team.oneCoordinator: A team has one coordinator. Use Make coordinator on a member to hand the role over.
team.inboxNote: Messages remain in the inbox until acknowledged. Automatic delivery, when enabled, submits them to the connected OxeChat conversation after it becomes idle. An uncertain delivery is never automatically repeated.

delivery.submitted: Submitted to session · receipt not confirmed
delivery.unknown: Delivery uncertain · check the session before sending again

team.limit: Showing up to 500 messages. Older messages remain saved.

firstRun.title: Before you start
firstRun.signInHint: Claude Code and Codex use your own subscription. OXESpace checks the sign-in once a folder is open; you can also sign in from a terminal with the agent itself.
firstRun.firstAnswer: First answer {{duration}} after you started. This stays on this computer.
firstRun.folderHint: Open a folder and ask an agent something: in an OxeChat conversation, or in an OxeCode workspace terminal.
firstRun.githubBefore: Pull requests and issues need the GitHub CLI signed in
firstRun.githubAfter: OXESpace checks it once a project is open.

usage.stale: Could not refresh. Showing the last known reading.
usage.title: Usage & rate limits
usage.description: Subscription limits reported by each provider. Percentages show allowance used, not remaining.
usage.footnote: Subscription quota differs from a conversation’s token and context usage.
usage.timeZone: Reset times use your local time zone
